calls.statement:
WITH lines AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.quantity, p.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, f.channel_code, f.staff_purchase_flag
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
)
SELECT sku, product_name, category, SUM(quantity) units, COUNT(*) n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) n_lines, SUM(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) staff_units, SUM(CASE WHEN channel_code='WB' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) wb_units
FROM lines GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 8

calls.statement:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27')
SELECT (SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM l) units_all, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM l) rows_, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM l) distinct_receipt_line,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM l) distinct_id, (SELECT SUM(units_sold) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') rpt_units,
 (SELECT MIN(sale_date)||' '||MAX(sale_date) FROM l) dates,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM l WHERE quantity<=0) nonpos_qty,
 (SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM l WHERE sku_is_test) x
FROM (SELECT 1) t, LATERAL (SELECT 0 sku_is_test) z
